triggers.name: New event on a calendar
triggers.description: Tells you once when an event appears on a calendar: created there, an invitation, or moved in. A repeating event counts once. Polls every 2 minutes; background reads stay on while it runs.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.

triggers.name: An event changed
triggers.description: Tells you when the title, time, place, description, repeat rule or status of an event you already had changed. One changed occurrence counts once. Guest answers and reminders do not count.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.

triggers.name: An event was cancelled
triggers.description: Tells you once when an event or one occurrence is cancelled, deleted or moved to another calendar. Google may send only its id, so the title can be missing.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.

triggers.name: An invitation needs your answer
triggers.description: Tells you once when someone invites you to an event and you have not answered. The title comes from the sender.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.

triggers.name: A guest answered your invitation
triggers.description: Tells you once for each answer a guest gives on an event you organize: accepted, declined or maybe. Only on events this calendar organizes.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.

triggers.name: An event is starting soon
triggers.description: Tells you once, ahead of the time you choose, when a timed event or one occurrence is about to start. All-day events and events already under way are left out. It runs only while this Mac is awake.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.

leadMinutes.description: How many minutes before the start to tell you.

triggers.name: Your calendar list changed
triggers.description: Tells you when a calendar is added to or removed from your list, or hidden or shown again. Google leaves a change of your access out of this list, so it shows only with the calendar's next change. Colours, names and notification settings do not count.

triggers.name: A calendar's sharing changed
triggers.description: Tells you when someone is added to a calendar's sharing, their role changes, or they are removed, including when a calendar is made public. Needs the sharing permission, and writer or owner access to that calendar.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars.
